heuristics.statement: For the fixed r = 34 walk map family F_rho0 of proof Section 1, with rho0 and x_0 drawn as in proof Section 3, the search of proof Section 3 at the parameters of proof Section 9 succeeds with probability at least 0.39 (the random-function bound of proof Section 5 is 0.3900024127183035402927579053066536765809418756930).
heuristics.scope: poseidon-orchard-r34-prefix-v1, the two-round line of proof Section 1, the parameters of proof Section 9.
heuristics.extrapolation: From a proved bound for a uniformly random function and from measurements at output widths 16 to 32 bits to the full 254-bit map; the bound exceeds 0.39 by 2.41e-06, so the premise needs the fixed map's success to be within that of the random-function value.
heuristics.limitations: Unproved. The pooled standard error of the collision-rate measurement is about 0.017 (about 3.4% at two standard errors), far above the deficit the filed budget tolerates: the budget has essentially no robustness margin (proof Section 9 gives the cost of absorbing a deficit).

heuristics.statement: Operation prices on the register machine of proof Section 7, whose listing (machine.py) is the algorithm: a declared file of 359 registers of 256 bits and 4-byte instructions, both counted in memory; field operations (canonical results), integer and bit operations, register moves and RAND 1; loads and stores 2 (access and address); compare-and-branch 2; jumps 1; instruction fetch not charged.
heuristics.scope: The cost and memory claims of this package.
heuristics.extrapolation: None; a declared convention, the same kind as the published entries' register files (the dependency 43caeb6a declares 469 at r = 56; our in-review 9f8717f0 declares 223 at r = 23; this package declares 359 at r = 34).
heuristics.limitations: The contract fixes no register count; proof Section 7 states the cost of a smaller file or of charging instruction fetch.
